resources.string: Your shows and new episodes will appear here.
Search for podcasts or paste a feed address here.
Episodes you add to Up Next will appear here.
No backup folder chosen. Backups are only kept on this phone, which won\'t help if the phone is lost.
Daily backups go to %1$s. The newest 7 are kept.
Couldn\'t write to the backup folder. Choose it again.
The library couldn\'t be copied for the backup. The app log has details.
The backup failed. The app log has details.
The library isn\'t open, so it can\'t be backed up.
Your subscriptions, queue, positions and settings will be replaced by the ones in the backup. A copy of the current library is saved first. The app restarts to finish.
That file isn\'t a Podplayer backup.
That backup is too large to restore.
That backup is from a newer version of Podplayer.
That backup doesn\'t look like one Podplayer made, so it wasn\'t used.
The backup file couldn\'t be read.
Your current library couldn\'t be saved first, so nothing was changed.
The library database failed its check when the app started. You can restore the backup from %1$s, or start with an empty library. The damaged file is kept either way.
The library database failed its check when the app started, and there is no backup to restore. You can start with an empty library; the damaged file is kept.
It was saved by a newer version of Podplayer. Install that version again; nothing was changed.
It needs updating, but the backup before the update failed, so it wasn\'t changed. Free some storage and restart the app.
